title: E4 needs a github.com PR URL, so no run under adapter none reaches R1 to R7
root_cause: draft_pr_gate.py accepts only https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n>; cadence-core and the dev branch have no local PR record under adapter none

title: P4 plan update drops the RUN_BY_COMMAND: plan-create marker, and every later handoff is refused
root_cause: the plan-update peer rewrites the plan without the provenance marker that the handoff hook requires

title: A plan review written at another path is never counted, P4 is refused, and P9 passes anyway
root_cause: the P3 peer wrote .context/plans/<id>.plan-review.md, not .context/reviews/plan_<id>.plan.md; the rewrite was not counted as a plan-review peer write, and the P9 entry invariant does not check that the review counts

title: P7 fails three times and the orchestrator cannot read why
root_cause: the orchestrator-scope guard (ADR-0017) hides the P7 scorecard, and the gate message does not print the failing rows, so the plan update cannot target them

title: Delivered pipelines map the ticket's checks to invented invariants or file paths, so no check parses
root_cause: nothing in the core traces the ticket's own requirement list (the seven checks) to a delivered proof; the answer map is never run against the spec's contract before delivery

title: adapter none can be set only inside the plugin tree, so a clean benchmark run cannot use the local PR mode
root_cause: jtouley/cadence reads adapter only from the plugin root's cadence.config.json (shared/skill_gate.py load_adapter, scripts/tracker_header.py no_tracker_declared, scripts/preflight.py), which says github-issues; a project .cadence.json cannot set it, so turning on adapter none edits the plugin tree, which loop.driver refuses

title: On P2, Cadence on Haiku takes 1.6 to 3.1 times the Haiku one-shot's agent time (stretch goal: 1.25)
root_cause: time goes to planning loops before any code. Peer time per block from the attest logs (loop.blocks, postmortem 2026-10-21-cadence-core-subscription): plan-review 28 calls and plan-update 35 calls over the batch, 52 of them repeat rounds; about 126 of 237 peer minutes were repeat rounds. P7 failed three times in two runs, and the third replanned from scratch after E1
